## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or use case. ("I'm frustrated
when...", "It's currently not possible to...")

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If you have a specific UI/behavior in mind,
describe it (mockups/sketches welcome but not required).

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Anything else

Mention here if you'd be interested in implementing it yourself (worth
opening this issue first to discuss approach, per
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
